scope: Read-only acceptance review of the v1.05 Qwiic master correction; no CAD mutations by reviewer.
verdict: PASS for the scoped Qwiic correction in saved CAD. No unresolved new Qwiic CAD blocker found. This is not full-board production qualification.

final_cosmetic_edit.DRC_retained_reason: Unchanged PCB and unchanged schematic connectivity/component values and footprints after cosmetic edit.

interface.master: J9 standard four-wire Qwiic to specified SparkFun WRL-15663 USB/battery-powered ESP32 Thing Plus
interface.sensors: J1, J12, J17 standard Qwiic powered from local +3V3
interface.U13: TCA9517ADGKR: local A, host B; EN to host VCCB; independently powered signal domains; common GND

footprint.evidence: Fresh independent IPC-2581 plus owner native placed-pad/library readback; TI SCPS245E DGK0008A land pattern pages 23-24.

rules.method: Supported native rule/netclass exports, plus read-only .kicad_pro board.design_settings, erc and net_settings metadata fallback because exports omit severity/exclusion fields. No source editing.

visual_verdict.result: No new visual layout defect found in reviewed Qwiic block. Pads/pin-one orientation, front/back routing, mask/paste openings, local bypass placement, QWIIC MASTER/HOST 3V3 IN and sensor +3V3 OUT labeling inspected. Final schematic text is clear after R83 spacing change.
visual_verdict.copper_comparison: Independent native copper-only PDFs before/after, rasterized at about 49.5um/pixel, show significant front/back copper differences localized to the new Qwiic block. Outside it, observed front-image changes were low-level antialiasing/segmentation noise. Filled polygon edges are not byte-identical and visual comparison does not prove exact continuous geometry.

conditions_and_remaining_validation: Use the specified direct ESP32 master topology. No arbitrary upstream B-side buffer or rise-time accelerator compatibility is asserted.

If using TCA9548A for multiple RheoBoards, enable only one branch at a time. Keep selected branch effective pullup resistance at least 2.2 kohm including tolerances/module parallel resistors, and total selected host pullup current at most 3 mA. See derivation in engineering review.
Confirm actual harness rise time, low levels, all four host/board power combinations, hot-plug and brownout behavior on hardware. Datasheet expectations are not measurements.
Existing U5 reset/startup finding remains open and was deliberately not changed. Pump/valve supply startup, transient and thermal qualification remains outside this Qwiic correction.
manufacturing_scope: BOM/CPL/fabrication-package reconciliation is owned by the root agent; this independent review does not substitute for those checks.
